title: Tight Security of Four-Round Cascaded LRW1
summary: Four-round cascaded LRW1 has a security proof at three quarters of n bits, but its tight security bound remains unresolved.

formal_statement.body: Determine the tight security of four-round cascaded LRW1 beyond the proved $3n/4$-bit bound.

scope.domain: Security bounds for cascaded LRW1 block-cipher constructions.
parameters: Four rounds, the fixed round count of the cascaded LRW1 construction
n, the variable governing the proved 3n/4-bit bound
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine the tight security bound beyond the proved 3n/4-bit bound.

progress.summary: The source presents four as the minimal round count for beyond-birthday-bound security and describes the known 3n/4-bit security proof for four-round LRW1 as non-tight.
citation_labels: Bishwajit Chakraborty et al., Tweakable Permutation-based Luby-Rackoff Constructions
